title: Ingestion halts on a SetOptions that adds a signed-payload signer (strict encoder rejects the signer)
severity_basis: A signer any account can add halted ingestion on default settings: five persist attempts, exit code 2, the cursor stays and a restart fails the same way. Executed at the pre-fix commit; fixed upstream, so the severity is the historical one.

entries.expected: ingestion continues and stores the signer added by the SetOptions operation
entries.observed: Executed at 2a0a84ea: five persist attempts over about 15.4 s, then exit code 2; ingest cursor stays at 4437356; no rows written for the ledger; a restart fails the same way. The lower bound of the range (the commit that introduced the strict encoder) is from source reading.

evidence.pre_fix: wallet-backend 2a0a84ea through the replay harness (make verify-replay), both inputs: mishandled · halt on testnet ledger 4437357.
evidence.post_fix: wallet-backend 2c873353 and the pinned current commit e967ce8b: pass on both inputs (make verify-replay).
evidence.expected_basis: stellar-core accepted the transaction on testnet (ledger 4437357); a signed-payload signer is a valid SignerKey (CAP-40).

reproduction.method: Independent reviewer reproduction from the record alone on 2026-11-12: 1 of 1 listed report rows failed again as recorded, all offline. Review: findings/review/F-0012.json.

evidence_added.reason: Fixed upstream; the upstream item already carries the reproduction and the fix, so no new evidence is added.

history.note: Created from the known divergences that reference https://github.com/stellar/wallet-backend/pull/729 and their failure rows.
The upstream item already records this defect.
